accessibleName.description:
Defines the accessible name of the component.

**Note:** Available since [v2.20.0](https://github.com/UI5/webcomponents/releases/tag/v2.20.0) of **@ui5/webcomponents**.

accessibleNameRef.description:
Receives id(or many ids) of the elements that label the component.

**Note:** Available since [v2.20.0](https://github.com/UI5/webcomponents/releases/tag/v2.20.0) of **@ui5/webcomponents**.

className.description:
CSS Class Name which will be appended to the most outer element of a component.
Use this prop carefully, overwriting CSS rules might break the component.

name.description:
Determines the name by which the component will be identified upon submission in an HTML form.

**Note:** This property is only applicable within the context of an HTML Form element.

**Note:** Available since [v2.0.0](https://github.com/UI5/webcomponents/releases/tag/v2.0.0) of **@ui5/webcomponents**.

onChange.description:
Fired when the the selected color is changed

| cancelable | bubbles |
| :--------: | :-----: |
| ❌|✅|

simplified.description:
When set to `true`, the alpha slider and inputs for RGB values will not be displayed.

**Note:** Available since [v2.5.0](https://github.com/UI5/webcomponents/releases/tag/v2.5.0) of **@ui5/webcomponents**.

style.description:
Element style which will be appended to the most outer element of a component.
Use this prop carefully, some css properties might break the component.

value.description:
Defines the currently selected color of the component.

**Note**: use HEX, RGB, RGBA, HSV formats or a CSS color name when modifying this property.

waitForDefine.description:
Defines whether the component should wait for the underlying custom element of the web component to be defined. This can be useful, for example, for using instance methods when mounting the component.

__Note:__ This adds a rendering cycle to your component.
